Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning voluntary donations of vehicle owners at the time of initial or renewal registration.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to voluntary donations of vehicle owners at thetime of initial or renewal registration; amending RCW 46.16.076; andadding a new section to chapter 43.79 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.076 and 2007 c 340 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall provide an opportunity for owners ofvehicles registered under RCW 46.16.0621 and vehicles licensed underRCW 46.16.070 with a declared gross weight of ten thousand pounds orless((,)) to make ((a)) the following voluntary donations ((of fivedollars)) at the time of initial or renewal registration((. Thedonation must)): (a) Five dollars to be deposited in the state parks renewal andstewardship account established in RCW 79A.05.215 to be used for theoperation and maintenance of state parks; (b) Five dollars to be deposited in the 4H account established insection 2 of this act to be used for life skills education for youngpeople from ages five through nineteen. p. 1 SB 5419 (2) This section applies to registrations due or to become due onor after January 1, 2008.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.79 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The 4H account is created in the custody of the statetreasurer. All receipts from voluntary donations collected under RCW46.16.076 must be deposited in the account. Only the state'sdesignated director of the 4H program or the director's designee mayauthorize expenditures from the account. The account is subject toallotment procedures under chapter 43.88 RCW, but an appropriation isnot required for expenditures. (2) Funds in the account must be disbursed for the purposes ofproviding life skills education for young people from ages five throughnineteen.
